reviews.author: Charlie O…
reviews.body:
Llevo haciéndome las uñas con Mario desde mucho antes de que tuviera su propio estudio, y sigo regresando porque siempre ofrece un servicio excepcional. Es profesional, detallista y realmente se preocupa por que sus clientes queden felices con el resultado.

Mis uñas siempre quedan hermosas y duran muchísimo. Si buscas calidad, atención personalizada y alguien que ame lo que hace, Mario es la mejor opción. ¡Lo recomiendo totalmente!

(Translated by Google)
I've been getting my nails done by Mario since long before he had his own studio, and I keep going back because he always provides exceptional service. He's professional, detail-oriented, and genuinely cares about making sure his clients are happy with the results.

My nails always look beautiful and last a very long time. If you're looking for quality, personalized attention, and someone who loves what they do, Mario is the best choice. I highly recommend him!
